subject.title: feat: unify external sessions with native catalog pagination

question: Should an active Codex plugin automatically expose local and paired-node session catalogs when `supervision.enabled` is false?
rationale: The patch overrides an existing explicit preference and changes transcript exposure for upgraded installations; only maintainers can approve that consent model.

options.title: Preserve explicit consent
options.body: Keep catalog and node-command registration behind the current opt-in or add a separately approved catalog setting with migration.

options.title: Approve plugin-active consent
options.body: Treat plugin activation as sufficient consent and ship explicit upgrade, permissions, and paired-node documentation and proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit consent
recommendation.body: Keep catalog and node-command registration behind the current opt-in or add a separately approved catalog setting with migration.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the existing catalog behavior and authored the current product-direction issue and implementation.
